claims.text: Both POL-RD-01 establishment tests pass on this trip's own evidence. The governing distance is gps_trace.trace_distance_km of 4.08 km on EV-GPS-00801, and the platform's booked optimal route on EV-TRIP-00801 is 3.15 km, so the measured excess is 0.93 km — 29.5% of optimal. That clears the 20% threshold and, at 0.93 km, also clears the 0.8 km absolute threshold; neither limb is marginal, and POL-RD-01 makes the trace figure govern over the rounded convenience copy on the trip record in any event.

The refund under POL-RD-02 is arithmetic, and it is SGD 1.45. Read on the FARE_BREAKDOWN EV-FARE-00801: charged_total 11.63, surge_multiplier 1.15 (read from the fare breakdown, which is the only artifact that carries it), promo_discount 0.60, waiting_time_fee 0.00, no ERP or toll lines and no airport surcharge. Recomputed fare = ((3.80 + 0.75 x 3.15 + 0.28 x 9.0) x 1.15) + 0.80 - 0.60 = 10.184875. Refund = 11.63 - 10.184875 = 1.445125, which is above the 0.50 de minimis, and the payable figure rounded UP to the nearest 0.05 is 1.45. The refund is 12.4% of charged_total, below the 90% full-refund share, so the correct outcome is PARTIAL_REFUND of 1.45 and not a refund of the whole 11.63 the claim invites the tribunal to review.

Nothing in the bundle exonerates the excess under POL-RD-03. EV-ADVIS-00801-01 is MISSING, weight_multiplier 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, with no payload — so there is no advisory naming a closed road or segment the optimal route traverses, no validity window and no shortest_lawful_alternative_km to run the clause on. I disclose the impairment and rely on the absence itself, which is citable: under POL-RD-13 POL-RD-03 is unavailable, any assertion of an external traffic cause cannot be tested and carries no weight under POL-RD-08, and the excess stands at the measured 0.93 km against the booked optimal of 3.15 km. There is in any event no counterparty statement on this file (the trip record's platform_policy is null and EV-CHAT-00801 is empty).

The chat log closes the POL-RD-04 route: EV-CHAT-00801 records message_count 0, first_message_at and last_message_at both null and truncated false, so there is no rider instruction, no named road and no chat_message.waypoint_hint that could be tested against the 200 m corroboration rule. No distance driven on this trip is attributable to a rider-requested detour and POL-RD-04 excludes nothing from the excess.

No endpoint was amended, so POL-RD-05 cannot be run and the baseline stays where POL-RD-01 puts it. EV-TRIP-00801 carries pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at both null, and amended_optimal_distance_km and amended_optimal_duration_min both null; there is no amendment timestamp, no re-quote, and no evidence of circling within 400 m of an amended point to exclude. The record's vehicle_type is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, so POL-RD-12's matched-itinerary baseline does not apply either and the booked optimal of 3.15 km is the correct comparator.

The trace is not impaired for policy purposes under POL-RD-07. EV-GPS-00801 carries 67 fixes at a 10 second sampling interval, coverage_pct 100.0, an empty gaps list and max_gap_sec 10 — far inside the 90 second gap limb and the 30 second sustained-interval limb. Because no limb of POL-RD-07(a) to (c) fires, the excess need not be corroborated by an independent source, POL-RD-10(3) is not engaged, and under POL-RD-13(2) the deviation stands at the figure measured on the trace.

The rider has discharged the POL-RD-08 initial burden and nothing has been cited to shift it back. EV-TRIP-00801, EV-GPS-00801 and EV-FARE-00801 all carry trip TRP-00801, and the fare breakdown's stored optimal_distance_km (3.15) and optimal_duration_min (9.0) are the same figures the trip record holds, so the artifacts describe the same trip; the excess of 0.93 km meets the POL-RD-01 threshold on an unimpaired trace. The burden then lies on the driver to point to a specific artifact and a specific clause, and there is no counterparty statement, no chat message and no advisory in the bundle for him to point to. The rider's own profile does not raise the corroboration bar: rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d is 0 and deviation_claims_60d_substantiated is 0, far below the four-claims-and-one-substantiated trigger.

This is a metered trip, so the distance remedy is open and no pass-through correction can enlarge or displace it. EV-FARE-00801 records fare_model METERED and quoted_fare_sgd null, so POL-RD-11 does not apply and POL-RD-02 governs. Equally, POL-RD-09 adds nothing here: erp_gantries is empty, tolls_erp is 0.00, no airport surcharge is charged, and the trip neither originates nor ends at an airport — so there is no billing-integrity defect and no off-route pass-through, and the 1.45 figure is the whole of the money the rider recovers on the fare.

The rider is presently carrying the disputed charge in full: EV-FARE-00801 shows payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00 against a charged_total of 11.63. Under POL-GEN-03 a PARTIAL_REFUND of 1.45 returns to the filing rider the part of the contested amount that was never earned, leaving the rider not carrying the charge for the 0.93 km driven beyond the platform's own optimal route.

The measured excess on this trip is 0.93 km, or 29.5% of the 3.15 km booking optimal (EV-GPS-00801, derived.deviation). That clears POL-RD-01's establishment gate — greater than 0.8 km and greater than 20% — but it is nowhere near the 8.0 km or 50% figures the same clause sets for a MATERIAL deviation. This is therefore a non-material overrun, and the POL-RD-06 driver-profile check, with the full-refund uplift it licenses, is not engaged on this trip.

On the only profile fields POL-RD-06 permits to be used (driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d and driver_profile.completed_trips_90d), the driver records 0 trailing-90-day deviation flags over 300 completed trips (EV-DPROF-00801). Neither limb of the POL-RD-06 pattern test is met: 0 is below 3, and 0/300 = 0.000 is below 0.05 with well over the 40 completed trips required. No repeat-deviation pattern can be established, so the POL-RD-06(b) full refund is unavailable and there is no footing for a POL-RD-06(c) conduct referral. No other profile field may be used for this test under POL-GEN-01.

The fare is METERED, so the rider's request to 'review the whole fare' of SGD 11.63 has no policy footing: POL-RD-02 measures the remedy as charged_total less a fare recomputed on the optimal route, not the whole fare. With the 1.15 surge multiplier read from the fare_breakdown, recomputed_fare = (3.80 + 0.75 x 3.15 + 0.28 x 9.0) x 1.15 + 0.80 platform fee + 0 ERP - 0.60 promo = 10.184875, giving a refund of 1.445125, rounded up to SGD 1.45. The exposure on this trip is that figure, not the 11.63 the rider asks the tribunal to review.

Nothing may be layered on top of that figure. The ERP lines on EV-FARE-00801 total 0.00 both on and off the optimal route, there is no airport surcharge line and no gantry the trace never crosses, and under POL-RD-09(1) any off-route ERP would already be comprehended in the POL-RD-02 refund rather than added to it. POL-RD-09 therefore contributes no further amount here.

The distance fig is a measured rather than an extrapolated one: the trace carries 67 fixes at the 10-second expected interval with 100% coverage, no gaps and a 10-second maximum gap (EV-GPS-00801). There is no broken stretch to reason across and no basis in the record from which an overrun larger than the measured 0.93 km could be inferred, so the case should be disposed of on the measured figure.

ruling.explanation: Both parties' core submissions are accepted. The trip is TRP-00801 throughout EV-TRIP-00801, EV-GPS-00801 and EV-FARE-00801. On EV-GPS-00801 the governing trace distance is 4.08 km, with 67 fixes, 100% coverage, max gap 10 seconds and 10-second sampling; the trace is not impaired under POL-RD-07(a)-(c). The booked optimal on EV-TRIP-00801 is 3.15 km, so the excess is 0.93 km, or 29.5% of optimal. Both POL-RD-01 establishment tests pass: greater than 20% and greater than 0.8 km. The deviation is not material (below 50% and below 8.0 km), so POL-RD-06 is not engaged; in any event EV-DPROF-00801 shows 0 deviation_flags_90d over 300 completed_trips_90d, so no repeat pattern, no POL-RD-06(b) uplift and no POL-RD-06(c) referral. The fare is METERED on EV-FARE-00801, so POL-RD-02 governs and POL-RD-11 does not apply. Using the fare-breakdown surge_multiplier 1.15, charged_total 11.63, optimal distance 3.15 km, optimal duration 9.0 min, platform fee 0.80, promo discount 0.60, and zero ERP, tolls, waiting time and surcharges: recomputed_fare = ((3.80 + 0.75 x 3.15 + 0.28 x 9.0) x 1.15) + 0.80 - 0.60 = 10.184875. Refund = 11.63 - 10.184875 = 1.445125, rounded UP to SGD 1.45. That is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis and below the 90% full-refund share, so the outcome is PARTIAL_REFUND. POL-RD-09 adds nothing: ERP lines are 0.00, there is no airport surcharge, and there is no unmatched gantry or billing-integrity referral. POL-RD-04, POL-RD-05 and POL-RD-12 excuse no excess: EV-CHAT-00801 is empty, no pickup or dropoff amendment is recorded, and the vehicle type is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL. The traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-00801-01 is MISSING, weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT; its absence means POL-RD-03 cannot exonerate the deviation, and it does not carry the deciding fact or reduce confidence. No counterparty statement is on file. The rider's request to review the whole SGD 11.63 is not granted as a full refund; the policy formula returns the partial amount of SGD 1.45. The monetary effect is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so it is executable automatically unless appealed. Confidence is 0.95, within the 1.0 weights of the GPS trace, trip record and fare breakdown that carry the deciding facts.

To both parties: the route driven was longer than the platform's own booking estimate, and a partial refund of SGD 1.45 is due to the rider. The driver keeps the remainder of the fare.

THE DEVIATION (POL-RD-01). The governing distance is the trace figure on EV-GPS-00801, trace_distance_km = 4.08 km. The booked optimal route is EV-TRIP-00801 optimal_distance_km = 3.15 km. The excess is 0.93 km, which is 29.5% of optimal. POL-RD-01 requires both more than 0.8 km absolute and more than 20%; both tests pass, so a deviation is established on this trip's own evidence. It is not a MATERIAL deviation (under 8.0 km and under 50%), so the POL-RD-06 driver-profile check is not triggered; in any event driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d = 0 over completed_trips_90d = 300, so no repeat-deviation pattern is established and no POL-RD-06(b) full-refund uplift or POL-RD-06(c) conduct referral arises.

THE REMEDY (POL-RD-02). The fare is METERED (EV-FARE-00801, fare_model METERED), so the refund is recomputed arithmetically. The 1.15 surge multiplier is read from the fare breakdown, the only artifact that carries it. Recomputed fare = ((3.80 + 0.75 x 3.15 + 0.28 x 9.0) x 1.15) + 0.80 platform fee + 0 ERP - 0.60 promo discount = 10.184875. Refund = charged_total 11.63 - 10.184875 = 1.445125, rounded UP to SGD 1.45. That is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis and is 12.4% of the amount charged, well below the 90% that would convert it to a full refund. The result is therefore PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 1.45, not the whole SGD 11.63 the rider asked to have reviewed.

NOTHING ELSE MOVES. No exculpatory clause applies. There is no traffic advisory: EV-ADVIS-00801-01 is MISSING, weight 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, so POL-RD-03 cannot be run and no external traffic cause was asserted or could be tested (POL-RD-13). The chat log EV-CHAT-00801 is empty (message_count 0, no waypoint_hint), so no rider-requested detour is exonerated under POL-RD-04. No endpoint was amended (pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at null, POL-RD-05), and the vehicle is RYDE_X, not a pooled itinerary, so POL-RD-12 does not apply. POL-RD-09 adds nothing: erp_gantries is empty, tolls_erp is 0.00, there is no airport surcharge on a trip that neither originates nor ends at an airport, and no charge line is unmatched, so there is no pass-through correction and no billing-integrity referral under POL-RD-09(4). The trace is NOT impaired under POL-RD-07 (67 fixes at the 10-second interval, 100% coverage, no gaps, max_gap_sec 10), so no independent corroboration is required and nothing escalates; the missing advisory is not a POL-RD-10(5) escalation because no party invoked an exculpatory clause against it. No driver compensation is due: the rider was billed 4.08 km against a trace of 4.08 km, so there is no unbilled-distance shortfall under POL-RD-04.

The monetary effect, SGD 1.45, is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold (POL-GEN-05) and executes automatically on issue. This ruling is provisional; either party may appeal once under POL-GEN-04 within 30 days.

RIDER: part of your fare is returned. DRIVER: the rest of the charge stands, and no adverse finding is made against you. The two of you are addressed together below.

WHAT WAS DRIVEN. The governing measurement is the GPS trace EV-GPS-00801 (weight_multiplier 1.0): 4.08 km between the recorded pickup and dropoff. The platform's booked optimal route on EV-TRIP-00801 is 3.15 km. The excess is 0.93 km, or 29.5% of optimal. Under POL-RD-01 both establishment tests pass (greater than 20% and greater than 0.8 km), so the route deviation is ESTABLISHED. It is not a MATERIAL deviation (the clause needs more than 50% or more than 8.0 km), so the POL-RD-06 driver-profile check is not required, no repeat-deviation pattern is found on the only citable counters (driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 over 300 completed_trips_90d on EV-DPROF-00801), and no POL-RD-06(c) conduct referral arises.

NOTHING EXONERATES THE EXCESS. There is no rider instruction: EV-CHAT-00801 carries message_count 0, so POL-RD-04 finds nothing to exclude and its 200 m corroboration test cannot be run. No endpoint was amended — the POL-RD-05 fields on EV-TRIP-00801 are all null — so the baseline stays at the booked 3.15 km. The vehicle type is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, so POL-RD-12 does not apply. The traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-00801-01 is MISSING (weight_multiplier 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, no payload), so POL-RD-03 cannot be run on it and, under POL-RD-13, no assertion of an external traffic cause carries weight; the excess stands at the measured 0.93 km.

THE MONEY. The fare is METERED and EV-FARE-00801 is the artifact the arithmetic runs on. Charged total: 11.63. Recomputed on the optimal route: ((3.80 base + 0.75 x 3.15 + 0.28 x 9.0 duration) x 1.15 surge multiplier read from the fare breakdown EV-FARE-00801) + 0.80 platform fee - 0.60 promo discount = 10.184875. Refund = 11.63 - 10.184875 = 1.445125. That is above the 0.50 de minimis, and at 12.4% of the charge it is well below the 90% full-refund share, so the correct outcome is a partial refund, rounded UP to SGD 1.45. To the rider's request to 'review the whole fare' of 11.63: the policy measures the remedy as the charged total less a fare recomputed on the optimal route, not the whole charge, so the exposure on this trip is SGD 1.45. There are no ERP lines, no tolls and no airport surcharge (erp_gantries empty, tolls_erp 0.00), so POL-RD-09 contributes nothing and nothing is added on top of or taken from that figure. The charge is presently CHARGED with 0.00 refunded.

CONFIDENCE AND PROCESS. The trace is not impaired for policy purposes under POL-RD-07: EV-GPS-00801 carries 67 fixes at a 10-second interval, 100% coverage, an empty gaps list and max_gap_sec 10 — inside the 90-second gap, 500 m jump and 30-second interval limbs. No independent corroboration is therefore needed and POL-RD-10(3) does not fire; no other POL-RD-10 trigger is present (identifiers match, timestamps do not run backwards, no unmatched charge line, refund of 1.45 is far below both 150.00 and the charged total). Confidence is 0.9, above the 0.70 floor, and the deciding artifacts (EV-GPS-00801, EV-TRIP-00801, EV-FARE-00801) all carry weight 1.0. The monetary effect of SGD 1.45 is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so the refund executes automatically. No referral is produced by any clause on these facts.

To the rider and the driver — the fare on trip TRP-00801 is reduced by SGD 1.45.

The governing distance is the GPS trace figure on EV-GPS-00801, trace_distance_km 4.08 km (POL-RD-01 makes the trace govern over the rounded copy on EV-TRIP-00801), against the booked optimal of 3.15 km on EV-TRIP-00801. The excess is not a MATERIAL deviation (below 50% and below 8.0 km), so the POL-RD-06 driver-profile check and its full-refund uplift are not engaged, and I note the driver's own POL-RD-06 figures (0 trailing-90-day deviation flags over 300 completed trips, EV-DPROF-00801) could not have met the pattern test in any event.

The booked optimal of 3.15 km therefore stands as the comparator.

THE ARITHMETIC (POL-RD-02). This is a METERED fare (EV-FARE-00801, fare_model METERED, quoted_fare_sgd null), so POL-RD-11 does not apply and the remedy is charged_total less a fare recomputed on the optimal route. Refund = 11.63 - 10.184875 = 1.445125, which is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis and below 90% of charged_total, so it is a PARTIAL_REFUND; rounded up to the nearest SGD 0.05 it is 1.45.

ON THE RIDER'S REQUEST TO REVIEW THE WHOLE FARE. The request to refund the entire 11.63 is rejected. POL-RD-02 measures the remedy as charged_total less a fare recomputed on the optimal route, not the whole fare, and the shortfall is 12.4% of the charge, not 90%. POL-RD-09 adds nothing: the ERP lines total 0.00 on and off the optimal route, there is no airport surcharge and no unmatched gantry, so there is no pass-through correction and no billing-integrity defect. The rider's own profile raises no corroboration bar (deviation_claims_60d 0).

CONFIDENCE AND EXECUTION. The deciding facts are carried by EV-GPS-00801, EV-TRIP-00801 and EV-FARE-00801, each at weight_multiplier 1.0, so the confidence cap is 1.0 and confidence is 0.90 — above the 0.70 floor, so no escalation. No clause produces a referral: there is no POL-RD-06(c) pattern and no POL-RD-09(4) billing-integrity failure. The monetary effect of SGD 1.45 does not exceed the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so it is executed automatically. The driver is owed nothing on this trip (no unbilled-distance shortfall: the fare was billed on 4.08 km, the distance the trace records), so driver_compensation_sgd is null.

The refund under POL-RD-02 is arithmetic, and it is SGD 1.45. Read on the FARE_BREAKDOWN EV-FARE-00801: charged_total 11.63, surge_multiplier 1.15 (read from the fare breakdown, which is the only artifact that carries it), promo_discount 0.60, waiting_time_fee 0.00, no ERP or toll lines and no airport surcharge. Recomputed fare = ((3.80 + 0.75 x 3.15 + 0.28 x 9.0) x 1.15) + 0.80 - 0.60 = 10.184875. Refund = 11.63 - 10.184875 = 1.445125, which is above the 0.50 de minimis, and the payable figure rounded UP to the nearest 0.05 is 1.45. The refund is 12.4% of charged_total, below the 90% full-refund share, so the correct outcome is PARTIAL_REFUND of 1.45 and not a refund of the whole 11.63 the claim invites the tribunal to review.

Nothing in the bundle exonerates the excess under POL-RD-03. EV-ADVIS-00801-01 is MISSING, weight_multiplier 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, with no payload — so there is no advisory naming a closed road or segment the optimal route traverses, no validity window and no shortest_lawful_alternative_km to run the clause on. I disclose the impairment and rely on the absence itself, which is citable: under POL-RD-13 POL-RD-03 is unavailable, any assertion of an external traffic cause cannot be tested and carries no weight under POL-RD-08, and the excess stands at the measured 0.93 km against the booked optimal of 3.15 km. There is in any event no counterparty statement on this file (the trip record's platform_policy is null and EV-CHAT-00801 is empty).

The chat log closes the POL-RD-04 route: EV-CHAT-00801 records message_count 0, first_message_at and last_message_at both null and truncated false, so there is no rider instruction, no named road and no chat_message.waypoint_hint that could be tested against the 200 m corroboration rule. No distance driven on this trip is attributable to a rider-requested detour and POL-RD-04 excludes nothing from the excess.

No endpoint was amended, so POL-RD-05 cannot be run and the baseline stays where POL-RD-01 puts it. EV-TRIP-00801 carries pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at both null, and amended_optimal_distance_km and amended_optimal_duration_min both null; there is no amendment timestamp, no re-quote, and no evidence of circling within 400 m of an amended point to exclude. The record's vehicle_type is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, so POL-RD-12's matched-itinerary baseline does not apply either and the booked optimal of 3.15 km is the correct comparator.

The trace is not impaired for policy purposes under POL-RD-07. EV-GPS-00801 carries 67 fixes at a 10 second sampling interval, coverage_pct 100.0, an empty gaps list and max_gap_sec 10 — far inside the 90 second gap limb and the 30 second sustained-interval limb. Because no limb of POL-RD-07(a) to (c) fires, the excess need not be corroborated by an independent source, POL-RD-10(3) is not engaged, and under POL-RD-13(2) the deviation stands at the figure measured on the trace.

The rider has discharged the POL-RD-08 initial burden and nothing has been cited to shift it back. EV-TRIP-00801, EV-GPS-00801 and EV-FARE-00801 all carry trip TRP-00801, and the fare breakdown's stored optimal_distance_km (3.15) and optimal_duration_min (9.0) are the same figures the trip record holds, so the artifacts describe the same trip; the excess of 0.93 km meets the POL-RD-01 threshold on an unimpaired trace. The burden then lies on the driver to point to a specific artifact and a specific clause, and there is no counterparty statement, no chat message and no advisory in the bundle for him to point to. The rider's own profile does not raise the corroboration bar: rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d is 0 and deviation_claims_60d_substantiated is 0, far below the four-claims-and-one-substantiated trigger.

This is a metered trip, so the distance remedy is open and no pass-through correction can enlarge or displace it. EV-FARE-00801 records fare_model METERED and quoted_fare_sgd null, so POL-RD-11 does not apply and POL-RD-02 governs. Equally, POL-RD-09 adds nothing here: erp_gantries is empty, tolls_erp is 0.00, no airport surcharge is charged, and the trip neither originates nor ends at an airport — so there is no billing-integrity defect and no off-route pass-through, and the 1.45 figure is the whole of the money the rider recovers on the fare.

The rider is presently carrying the disputed charge in full: EV-FARE-00801 shows payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00 against a charged_total of 11.63. Under POL-GEN-03 a PARTIAL_REFUND of 1.45 returns to the filing rider the part of the contested amount that was never earned, leaving the rider not carrying the charge for the 0.93 km driven beyond the platform's own optimal route.

The measured excess on this trip is 0.93 km, or 29.5% of the 3.15 km booking optimal (EV-GPS-00801, derived.deviation). That clears POL-RD-01's establishment gate — greater than 0.8 km and greater than 20% — but it is nowhere near the 8.0 km or 50% figures the same clause sets for a MATERIAL deviation. This is therefore a non-material overrun, and the POL-RD-06 driver-profile check, with the full-refund uplift it licenses, is not engaged on this trip.

On the only profile fields POL-RD-06 permits to be used (driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d and driver_profile.completed_trips_90d), the driver records 0 trailing-90-day deviation flags over 300 completed trips (EV-DPROF-00801). Neither limb of the POL-RD-06 pattern test is met: 0 is below 3, and 0/300 = 0.000 is below 0.05 with well over the 40 completed trips required. No repeat-deviation pattern can be established, so the POL-RD-06(b) full refund is unavailable and there is no footing for a POL-RD-06(c) conduct referral. No other profile field may be used for this test under POL-GEN-01.

The fare is METERED, so the rider's request to 'review the whole fare' of SGD 11.63 has no policy footing: POL-RD-02 measures the remedy as charged_total less a fare recomputed on the optimal route, not the whole fare. With the 1.15 surge multiplier read from the fare_breakdown, recomputed_fare = (3.80 + 0.75 x 3.15 + 0.28 x 9.0) x 1.15 + 0.80 platform fee + 0 ERP - 0.60 promo = 10.184875, giving a refund of 1.445125, rounded up to SGD 1.45. The exposure on this trip is that figure, not the 11.63 the rider asks the tribunal to review.

Nothing may be layered on top of that figure. The ERP lines on EV-FARE-00801 total 0.00 both on and off the optimal route, there is no airport surcharge line and no gantry the trace never crosses, and under POL-RD-09(1) any off-route ERP would already be comprehended in the POL-RD-02 refund rather than added to it. POL-RD-09 therefore contributes no further amount here.

The distance fig is a measured rather than an extrapolated one: the trace carries 67 fixes at the 10-second expected interval with 100% coverage, no gaps and a 10-second maximum gap (EV-GPS-00801). There is no broken stretch to reason across and no basis in the record from which an overrun larger than the measured 0.93 km could be inferred, so the case should be disposed of on the measured figure.
